evals.prompt: Run orchestrator happy path with all required artifacts present and a 3-rule queue.
evals.expected_output: State reaches DONE and rule-status lists all rules DONE.
Fail fast with ARTIFACT_MISSING and write failure-summary.json.

evals.prompt: Run orchestrator with empty source manifest and simulate AWAITING_SOURCE_INPUT handoff state.
